problem: The daily filings get done, daily
action: The same office desk as the earlier shot of him buried in paper — but now the desk is clear and tidy. The dealer is not at it. He is standing behind it with his hand on the back of the chair, about to leave the room, glancing back at a desk that has nothing waiting on it.
lighting: Bright clean morning light across an empty uncluttered desk surface. Airy. The room reads calm and finished.
camera: Waist-up, the empty desk running across the lower third of the vertical frame, the dealer standing behind it. Sharp. 35mm. Deliberately the mirror of the paper-stack shot.
detail: The desk is EMPTY — no paper, no forms, no files, no writing, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere in the room. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: The work still happened. It just did not happen to him.
motion: He pats the chair back once and turns very slightly away. A slow push in. Nothing else moves, no cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: एस-डी-एम-एस का रोज़ का काम, रोज़ हो जाता है।
